name: playtest-recorder
description: Electron recorder shell: drives OBS over obs-websocket, registers mark hotkeys, writes the session sidecar. UI closes during recording (tray only).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
